note: Deterministic baseline proposer (NO LLM). Its role is to prove the pipeline + gate run end-to-end offline and to set an honest floor a semantic proposer must beat — it is NOT evidence that a semantic proposer works.
generated_at_note: no timestamp recorded on purpose: the output must be byte-reproducible

envelope.concern: a package-level dependency cycle (SCC) indicates ownership inversion: a lower layer imports upward, so the cycle must be cut at its cheapest outermost edge

candidate_interventions.title: slice the cheapest root->subdir edge out of the SCC
investigate which member the cut node is the sole in-edge for
candidate_interventions.rationale: a cut can strand reachable-only-through-it members

in_scope: cut the single cheapest root->subdir import edge
move the shared primitive to the correct ownership layer
non_goals: do not clear the whole SCC in one slice
do not touch unrelated cycle members

envelope.expected_mechanical_delta: package SCC size decreases by at least one member, with the other members unchanged
envelope.negative_control: re-inject one edge with a REAL (used) import and confirm the cut member returns to the SCC
envelope.abandon_or_reconsider_condition: abandon if the fix requires creating a new edge between two other packages, or if another member leaves the SCC unexpectedly

confidence.basis: derived deterministically from the case's own archguard readings; no semantic judgement applied

scores.note: rule-assisted, minimal-viable metrics — not a calibrated aggregate score (see README.md)

envelope.concern: duplicate or dispersed implementations of one concept indicate an ownership problem: the concept has no canonical home, so consumers each carry a copy

candidate_interventions.title: investigate equivalence before merging
candidate_interventions.rationale: structural similarity is not semantic equivalence

candidate_interventions.title: give the shared logic one canonical owner and let the rest delegate to it

in_scope: sink the shared implementation to one canonical owner
migrate the real consumers, not look-alikes
non_goals: do not merge merely-similar implementations without checking equivalence first
do not touch unrelated dispersed definitions

envelope.expected_mechanical_delta: the duplicate-detection group disappears and the canonical definition count drops to 1
envelope.negative_control: verify BOTH call chains actually changed what they call, not that the file merely moved
envelope.abandon_or_reconsider_condition: abandon if the two implementations turn out to be intentionally-divergent rather than equivalent

confidence.basis: derived deterministically from the case's own archguard readings; no semantic judgement applied
